title: How Did PlayStation Make Record Profit?
description:
How did PlayStation make record profit while selling fewer consoles?

Sources:
- Sony FY2025 consolidated results presentation, May 8 2026 (mirror): https://investgame.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2026-05-08-25q4_sony_earnings_clean_wp.pdf
- Inven Global: Sony posts record gaming operating profit: https://www.invenglobal.com/articles/21682/sony-posts-record-gaming-operating-profit-though-bungie-impairment-casts-a-shadow

Sony's fiscal 2025 = year ended March 31, 2026. Operating income includes a 120.1 billion yen Bungie impairment; FY2026 forecast: sales down 6%, operating income 600 billion yen. Not financial advice.

#shorts #playstation #gaming #howtheymakemoney

loop: So next time you buy a game on PlayStation, ask yourself:

scenes.narration: How did PlayStation make record profit while selling fewer consoles?
Sony's game business just had its best year. Operating income hit a record 463 billion yen.

visual.label: Game & Network Services operating income, FY2025 (yen)

scenes.narration: But sales stayed flat, at about 4.7 trillion yen. And fewer consoles were sold.
The growth came from network services, and from games made by other studios.
And 125 million accounts played in March, a record for that time of year.
Sony even expects profit to rise next year, while selling fewer consoles again.
